categories.name: Admission to Non-Critical Ward
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an inpatient non-critical ward. Advances the goal of reaching a documented disposition and contributes to minimizing time-to-treatment or avoiding post-discharge deterioration, evaluated against post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Admission NC (id=15) under the OR decomposition of Patient is admitted to an inpatient ward (id=5). The narrative sample shows this alternative realized in standard inpatient ward admissions (e.g., variant V0008).

categories.name: Admission to Intensive Care
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an intensive care inpatient ward. Associated with intensive monitoring and treatment paths, having a negative contribution to minimizing time-to-treatment softgoals, and evaluated against post-discharge performance indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Admission IC (id=16) under the OR decomposition of Patient is admitted to an inpatient ward (id=5). The narrative sample shows this alternative realized in more severe cases requiring intensive care pathways (e.g., variant V0605).
